source_evidence:
Day327~15:48 exact player 'Understood, thank you.

Regroup and assess situation' thanks Tavosk, authorizes ordinary departure from completed audience and private party discussion along quieter Exchange district side street. No contested exit, no observed follower, no guarantee against unseen surveillance. No new V dialogue beyond explicit words, payment, Watch visit, appointment, magic, or further investigation. Mara independently assesses that they have corroborating personal admissions from Halvessa and Sallow about undeclared household purchases, Sallow's account of broker/Tavosk roles, Harthvale identification as freight association head, and Tavosk's own paid warning offer and accepted6gp commission. She says 'We have gone from a case of lace to an actual commercial arrangement, and the people who make it work. Harthvale is the missing conversation, not a conviction.' Cirren says 'The receipt is deliberately vague, but we all heard what the six gold bought. Desen needs to hear that, and see both papers. He told us not to commit to anything; we should be completely candid about the payment. I would rather let him decide whether we need to wait for the notice or whether he has enough to act.' Cirren distinguishes actual firsthand admissions from legal corroboration and does not promise warrant or arrest. Fenar says 'Master, Fenar wants to know whether these people are involved with the killings, or whether they just make their money off the boats. Fenar does not want us accusing the wrong people.' No new murder link or specific prohibited cargo established. Mara suggests leaving both pending correspondence channels open at Copper Hart while reporting actual afternoon evidence to Desen; no automatic return to inn, report, notice delivery, message dispatch, Harthvale appointment, or resource change. All four remain together near Exchange. V next decision pending.
